senses.zh_definition: 卡西法：奇幻作品《哈尔的移动城堡》中的火魔角色名。
senses.en_definition: Calcifer, the fire demon in Howl’s Moving Castle.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi watak makhluk api dalam Howl’s Moving Castle; takrif penerangan, bukan petikan definisi rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 这是专有名词的一种可核实指称，不能仅凭输入判断所有出现位置都指该角色。输入没有 DBP 释义，故不标为官方马来语词条。下列搭配是说明性短语，未获语料频率验证。角色身份见 [Disney D23](https://d23.com/a-to-z/howls-moving-castle/)。

dual_scenarios.zh: 那篇影评讨论了卡西法在《哈尔的移动城堡》中的作用。
dual_scenarios.en: The film review discusses Calcifer’s role in Howl’s Moving Castle.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友讨论电影；例句为编写示例
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku suka Calcifer lah, suara dia kelakar.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya suka akan Calcifer kerana suaranya lucu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我很喜欢卡西法啦，他的声音很好笑。
dual_scenarios.en: I really like Calcifer. His voice is funny.
spoken_features: aku 是朋友间的非正式第一人称

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah tengok filem tu? Aku suka Calcifer lah.
messages.ms_standard: Awak sudah menonton filem itu? Saya suka akan Calcifer.
messages.zh: 你看过那部电影了吗？我很喜欢卡西法啦。
messages.en: Have you seen that film? I really like Calcifer.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah. Aku nak tengok lagi sebab dia kelakar.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah. Saya mahu menontonnya lagi kerana watak itu lucu.
messages.zh: 看过了。他太好笑了，我还想再看一次。
messages.en: Yes. I want to watch it again because he’s so funny.

etymology.historical_story: Calcifer belongs to the fictional world of Howl’s Moving Castle, rather than to an established Malay word family. Malay readers encounter the name through discussion of the story and its film adaptation. Its association with a fire demon is documented, but that association alone does not establish the linguistic origin of the name. See [Disney D23](https://d23.com/a-to-z/howls-moving-castle/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Calcifer 与城堡炉火里的卡西法形象绑定记忆；这是角色联想，不是已证实的语源解释。
